name: Car Attendant
author: ashenmare
description: Riders stop marking you down for a coach that's a little worn. It does not repair cars or change their condition: it changes how the riders rate a worn coach in reputation's Passenger: Equipment Condition. A coach at the threshold (80% by default) or better counts as perfect; below it the score falls off in proportion (40% counts as 50%). Set the threshold in Preferences > Mods; 100% is the game's own rating. Host side.
